_about: Pratibimb model slots. Each AI step has a fixed input and output; 'default' is what runs today, 'trained' is where a model we train is dropped in (an ONNX file with the stated inputs/outputs). pipeline.py and the player read this file. docs/pratibimb/TRAINING.md explains how to train each one.

face_controls.input: the person's face points: float32[478,3] per photo (MediaPipe Face Landmarker, image pixels, z scaled like x), plus head turn (yaw, pitch, roll, degrees)
face_controls.output: float32[222] MakeHuman face-control values in 0..1, names in face_controls_names (training/face_controls/names.json)
face_controls.default: solve_face.py (relative least-squares fit over all photos)

lipsync.output: float32[frames,52] ARKit blendshapes at 30 fps (names in the model's config.json, ARKit order)
lipsync.default: wav2arkit_cpu (Apache-2.0, myned-ai) + Pratibimb rules (p/b/m closure, f/v, 40 ms lead, smoothing, gains)

voice.input: text (English / Hindi / Hinglish) + the person's consented reference clip (16-24 kHz, 10-60 s)
voice.output: mono audio (24 kHz) with a watermark, plus word timings when available
voice.default: Kokoro via HeadTTS (fixed Indian voices); cloning: Chatterbox Multilingual + Hindi (MIT) on a GPU

skin.input: the best even-lit photo, its camera and the fitted head mesh
skin.output: a 2048x2048 skin texture in the MakeHuman UV layout

likeness.input: a render and the person's held-out photos
likeness.output: a likeness score in percent of the photo-vs-photo ceiling

gestures.input: the sentence, its word timings and prosody (prosody.py)
gestures.output: a list of gestures [name, start s, end s, strength] from the gesture library
gestures.default: rules in the player: beats on stressed words, point when the board is referenced, nod on agreement
